subject: Clarifications on Order Form, Indemnity and IP in RFP Response
messages:
From: Alicia Moss <alicia.moss@orchidfs.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: geoff.lang@orchidfs.com
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP legal questionnaire - a few follow-ups

Neha — thanks for the RFP materials. Our sourcing team reviewed Redwood's legal responses and we have a few clarifying questions before we circulate to procurement counsel:

1) Indemnity: your response references a mutual indemnity with carveouts for indirect damages. Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept an indemnity for third-party IP claims limited to customer data use of the service (not customer applications)?

2) Liability cap: the questionnaire asks for a recommended cap. Please state Redwood's preferred cap (we asked for both $ cap and multiple-of-fees).

3) Order form / billing: we want to confirm the billing cadence and whether you can accept a 60-day invoice term for enterprise customers.

4) IP assignment: our legal team sometimes asks for bespoke language — does Redwood ever assign modifications or derivative works created by Customer?

We have attached the questionnaire (v3) and the initial statement of work. If it's easier, happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Alicia Moss
Sr. Sourcing Manager
Orchid Financial Services

Attachments: Orchid_RFP_Legal_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx, Statement_of_Work_v1.pdf

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Moss <alicia.moss@orchidfs.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP legal questionnaire - a few follow-ups

Alicia — appreciate the clear list. Looping in Monica (our senior counsel) and Priyom (sales lead) to draft definitive answers. Preliminary responses below so your counsel has context while we formalize redlines:

• Indemnity: Redwood offers indemnity for third-party IP claims arising solely from the model/service as delivered (e.g., model infra, model weights we provide). We do not accept indemnity for customer-developed prompts or customer applications. We can provide standard language that limits indemnity to claims resulting from our breach of representations and actual infringement.

• Liability cap: our standard practice is a cap equal to the greater of $1,000,000 or 1x the 12-month fees paid under the order form. We'll let Monica advise if there is flexibility for larger enterprise contracts.

• Billing terms: we typically bill net 30. Net 60 can be accommodated on a case-by-case basis for enterprise customers with procurement approval and a credit check; we document that in the order form.

• IP assignment: Redwood does not assign core model IP or underlying model improvements. For Customer-created content (prompt + inputs + outputs), we grant the customer the rights necessary to use the outputs. We can include a clause clarifying no assignment of Redwood pre-existing materials.

We'll send formal language and a sample order form redline by EOD tomorrow. If you need a call, I'm available Tue 9–11 PT.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Moss <alicia.moss@orchidfs.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP legal questionnaire - a few follow-ups

Alicia / Neha — attaching proposed redline snippets for the questionnaire items. Summary points below and I included the redline in the attached Excel columns.

1) IP indemnity scope: we will indemnify Customer only for third-party claims that the Service, as provided by Redwood, infringes a third party's patent/copyright/trademark. The indemnity will exclude any claim arising from: (a) Customer data or prompts; (b) customer modifications; (c) combination with third-party software. We also require: (i) prompt notice; (ii) sole control of defense; (iii) cooperation.

2) Remedy for infringement: Redwood will, at our option, (i) obtain a license, (ii) replace/modify the Service, or (iii) terminate the affected Service and refund fees for the affected period.

3) Liability cap: propose greater of $2,000,000 or 2x the relevant 12-month fees for strategic accounts. For standard enterprise deals we are comfortable with $1,000,000 or 1x 12-month fees; we can escalate for exceptions.

4) Billing: we can accept net 60 with a signed credit amendment and invoice schedule in the order form.

5) IP assignment: we will not assign our pre-existing model IP or improvements. Customer retains ownership of Customer Data and any downstream outputs to the extent permitted by law; we recommend clarifying license rights rather than assignment.

Attachments: Redwood_RFP_Redline_snippets.xlsx

Thanks — happy to discuss with your counsel if they want to negotiate specific caps or carveouts.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Moss <alicia.moss@orchidfs.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP legal questionnaire - a few follow-ups

Alicia — quick commercial note from my side: Orchid is a strategic-looking account so Monica's suggestion on a higher cap (2x or $2M) is fine to consider. If procurement needs an alternative, we're open to a tiered approach: standard cap for core services and a higher cap for dedicated/support add-ons or SLA credits. Also happy to offer a capped credit/termination remedy if a critical IP claim actually disrupts production.

Neha — I'll let you lead the pricing/order form adjustments; please include an explicit clause for net-60 requests so finance has a clear workflow.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai

Alicia — thanks for the patience. Attached are the formal items: (1) Redwood_RFP_Redline_snippets.xlsx with proposed language, (2) Redwood_Sample_Order_Form_2025.pdf showing billing cadence and the credit/finance workflow, and (3) SOC2_TypeII_Report_stub.pdf for your security team. Highlights: 

• Indemnity: attached redline includes our standard IP indemnity limited to claims arising from Redwood's delivery of the Service; exclusions for Customer prompts/apps included.
• Liability cap: default = greater of $1,000,000 or 1x 12-month fees; for strategic customers (mutually agreed) we can move to $2,000,000 or 2x 12-month fees.
• Billing: net 60 available with signed credit amendment; sample clause on p.3 of the order form.
• IP assignment: no assignment of Redwood pre-existing IP. We include customer-rights language for outputs and deliverables.

Please review the attachments and let us know if your counsel wants tracked changes on the order form. If helpful, I can set up a time for Monica to talk to your procurement counsel directly.
